question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the climate of the Indian subcontinent?

options.text: The Thar desert protects the subcontinent from extremely cold winds from central Asia.
The Himalayas protect the subcontinent from extremely cold winds from central Asia.
The climate of North India remains similar throughout the year.
The Western Ghat protects the subcontinent from extremely cold winds from central Asia.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Himalayas protect the subcontinent from extremely cold winds from central Asia.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Himalayas protect the Indian subcontinent from extremely cold winds from central Asia i**s correct 
 
• The Himalayas **are a mountain range that block cold air masses from Central Asia from moving south into India**. 
 
• This prevents the** Northern Plains from freezing cold during the winter. **
 
• The Himalayas a**lso act as a barrier to moisture-laden monsoon winds. **
 
• The Thar Desert attracts the moisture-laden southwest summer monsoon winds that bring most of India's rainfall. 
 
• The climate of India is tropical monsoon type, with a distinct wet and dry climate. 
 
• The climate of India ranges from tropical in the south to temperate and alpine in the Himalayan north. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** climate of the Indian subcontinent is tropical monsoon, with distinct wet and dry seasons.**
 
• The climate varies a**cross the region due to its diverse topography, latitudes, and the influence of the Himalayas and Indian Ocean. **
 
• **Seasons **
 
 
• **Summer:** March to June, with temperatures reaching up to 40°C in some areas
 
• **Pre-monsoon: **Thunderstorms are common in the northeast and east
 
• **Monsoon:** July to September, with three-quarters of the country's yearly rainfall
 
• **Autumn:** October to December, with temperatures and humidity decreasing
 
• **Winter:** January and February, with temperatures ranging from 10°C to 15°C in the northwest and 20°C to 25°C in the southeast
